nodes.title: EDIT PROMPT • MiniMax H3 Image
INFO / HOW TO USE (EDIT)
widgets_values:
## ZetaLvX | MiniMax H3 Image Edit | Core v1 • EN
**Only built-in ComfyUI 0.45+ nodes. No custom nodes required.**

**How to use**
1. Load your source image in the **LoadImage** node. That image becomes `<Picture 1>` for MiniMax editing.
2. Write your edit request in the **EDIT PROMPT** node.
3. Change the **ASPECT RATIO** in the ResolutionSelector if you want a different target canvas.
4. Change **TARGET MEGAPIXELS** in the Float node from 4 to 20.
5. Click **Queue / Run**. Width and height are calculated automatically and rounded to multiples of 32.

**Editing advice**
- Be explicit about what must change and what must stay the same.
- Mention identity, pose, composition, or background if you want them preserved.
- For text or graphic edits, specify the exact readable text you want.

**Sampling:** 6 steps, Euler, Simple, CFG = 1, denoise = 1.
**Prompt Enhancement:** intentionally excluded for reliability and speed.

**Brand / links**
- YouTube: https://youtube.com/@zetalvx
- Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/Zetalvx
- GitHub: https://github.com/ZETALVX

widgets_values_named.text:
## MiniMax H3 Image | Core v1 • ITA
**Solo nodi integrati in ComfyUI 0.45+; nessun custom node.**

**Come usarlo**
1. Scrivi il prompt nel nodo **PROMPT**.
2. Cambia il **FORMATO** nel nodo ResolutionSelector (1:1, 4:3, 3:2, 16:9, 9:16, 21:9...).
3. Cambia il valore **MEGAPIXEL REALI** nel nodo Float da 4 a 20.
4. Clicca **Esegui**. Le dimensioni vengono calcolate automaticamente e arrotondate a multipli di 32.

**Importante:** nel ResolutionSelector, lascia `megapixels = 16` e `multiple = 32`: il primo e solo un riferimento geometrico (serve anche a preservare bene il rapporto); i MP effettivi li regoli nel nodo Float.

**Profili consigliati**
- 4 MP = diagnostica rapida.
- 8–10 MP = confronto e sviluppo prompt.
- 16 MP = prima prova qualitativa.
- 20 MP = stress test, VRAM/RAM e tempi più elevati.

**Sampling**: 6 step, Euler, Simple, CFG=1, denoise=1.
**PE**: assente per scelta; i tre modelli disponibili sono sufficienti. Non confondere PE con il text encoder principale.
**RTX 3090 24 GB**: probabilmente servirà offload per le taglie più alte; valuta tempi/qualità, monitora RAM e VRAM.

**Compatibilità**: se compare un errore `ModelVBAR ... pageout_callback`, aggiornare soltanto `comfy-aimdo` (non Torch).

nodes.title: MODEL SET / NOTES
widgets_values:
# Installed model set
**UNET:** `minimax_h3_image_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors`

**CLIP / Text Encoder:** `qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_int8_convrot.safetensors`

**VAE:** `minimax_h3_image_vae_fp16.safetensors`

This workflow does **not** require a fourth model. You can still swap checkpoints later from the dropdown menus.

### Why is Prompt Enhancement not included?
It is intentionally excluded: the PE model recommended by Comfy-Org is `qwen3.5_9b_w4a8_gptq`, not the main Qwen3-VL 32B text encoder. This keeps the workflow simple, fast, and avoids huge text-generation overhead locally.

widgets_values_named.text:
# Modelli già installati
**UNET:** `minimax_h3_image_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors`

**CLIP:** `qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_int8_convrot.safetensors`

**VAE:** `minimax_h3_image_vae_fp16.safetensors`

**Non serve alcun quarto modello** per questa versione. I menu consentono di sostituire i checkpoint quando li scarichi.

### Perché manca il Prompt Enhancement?
Lo abbiamo volutamente escluso: il modello PE consigliato da Comfy-Org è `qwen3.5_9b_w4a8_gptq`, non il CLIP Qwen3-VL 32B. Così il workflow funziona subito con i tuoi tre file senza 8.192 token di generazione testo.

nodes.title: QUALITY / RESOLUTION
widgets_values:
# Resolution and quality
The model renders directly at the requested resolution: **no upscaler is used**.

Reference ~16–17 MP sizes published by MiniMax:
- Square: `4096 × 4096`
- 4:3: `4736 × 3552`
- 3:2: `5024 × 3360`
- 16:9: `5472 × 3072`
- 21:9: `6272 × 2688`

The dynamic control uses **exact decimal megapixels** (1 MP = 1,000,000 pixels), so it does not try to force the exact preset dimensions from the official table.

For clean comparisons: keep the same seed, prompt, steps, and sampler.

Steps are **6** because the model is distilled and does not use a classic negative prompt or standard CFG workflow.

widgets_values_named.text:
# Risoluzione e qualità
Il modello produce direttamente i pixel alla risoluzione impostata: **nessun upscale**.

Formati di riferimento ~16–17 MP pubblicati da MiniMax:
- Square: `4096 × 4096`
- 4:3: `4736 × 3552`
- 3:2: `5024 × 3360`
- 16:9: `5472 × 3072`
- 21:9: `6272 × 2688`

Il controllo dinamico usa **MP decimali esatti** (1 MP = 1.000.000 pixel), anziché riprodurre necessariamente le dimensioni preset della tabella.

Per confronti corretti: seed fisso, prompt identico, stessi step e sampler.

Gli step sono **6** perché il modello è distillato e non usa negative prompt o CFG classico.

nodes.title: EDITING NOTES
widgets_values:
# Editing behavior
The image loaded in **LoadImage** is sent as `<Picture 1>`. The MiniMax edit model can preserve or transform the image depending on your prompt.

Suggested prompt pattern:
`Preserve the subject identity, pose and framing. Change ... Keep ...`

You can later add more reference images by extending the workflow and connecting them to additional `images.image_n` inputs on the conditioning node.
